info.name: Listrak Cross Channel REST app-push-mobile-client-device PhoneList API

params.name: senderCodeId
params.description: Identifier used to specify the Sender Code.

params.name: status
params.description: Status of list types to retrieve.  The default value is `active`.  Options are `active` or `inactive`

params.name: cursor
params.description: Value indicating the page of data that's being retrieved. The default value is `Start`.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of data members to be displayed per page. The default value is `1000` and the maximum value is `5000`.

items.docs: Retrieve a collection of SMS Lists for a sender code by list status.

params.description: Identifier used to specify SMS List.
